preview: An interview experience for the Technology Analyst Intern role at Fiserv featuring a Group Discussion, Technical Interview, and HR Interview.
content: Fiserv Role: Technology Analyst Intern Vishal Dange | VJTI B.Tech. IT’23 Rounds : 0) CGPA Shortlisting 1) Group Discussion – 30th September 2. Technical Interview – 1st October 3) HR Interview – 1st October Fiserv : Fiserv, Inc. is a global provider of payments and financial services technology solutions. The Company provides account processing and digital banking solutions, card issuer processing and network services, payments, e-commerce, merchant acquiring and processing, and the Clover cloud-based point-of-sale solution. Fiserv visited our campus on 29 September ,2021 for the On-Campus Internship Drive. Eligibility: 6+ CGPA Branches: Computer Engineering , Information Technology ,Electronics & Telecommunication , CGPA Shortlisting – Fiserv Shortlisted people based on CGPA. Only those people having CGPA > 8.0 were allowed to sit for further rounds . So, try to keep your CGPA at least 8.0. Group Discussion (GD) Round - Fiserv had informed us about this round just a day before , and we have been expecting Coding round but they had not taken any coding round, and GD round started from 9:00 AM on 30th September. So, I had gone through all the GD topics asked in interviews and practiced these topics explaining myself in front of camera. ( P.S. : So, if you prepare this before hand, you will not fumble in the interview) GD Topic : Women empowerment and Gender Injustice Points to keep in mind : • Be Calm . • Try to speak to the point • Ask right Questions • They want to check how good team player you are and also your communication skills will be tested. This round went well. After a day ,they have shortlisted around 44 candidates for next round and I was one of them. Technical Round:(25 minutes) As I had not found any Interview Experience of Fiserv anywhere. So I asked my seniors about how was interview process and questions . Always read the past year experiences because it really helps in the interview. My Round was scheduled at 10:00 AM The interview lasted around 25 mins. ● The interview started with the standard question of tell me about yourself ● Then she gone through my resume and asked to explain my project ( Bookxchanger). ● Since, I have used MERN stack in my project, she asked me to explain MERN stack in detail . Then she asked why you preferred MongoDB over SQL ( A pretty standard question on project) . ● She asked me SQL Queries regarding Create, Adding Keys to Table ,Clauses , her intention was to check if I am familiar with basic SQL queries or not. ● Then she asked about size of varchar(). ● She moved on to my next project and asked me How CRUD application works ( As I had mentioned in my resume ). ● Then She asked me OOPs concepts such as what is Inheritance. Explain with the help of example. From 44, 30 people were shortlisted for next round i.e. HR round and I was one of them. My round was scheduled at 12:00 PM. HR Round: Basically, HR round is to check how fit you are for the given role. HR round started with my introduction. He was trying to make me comfortable by asking questions like how are you ? Where do you live ? etc. It was more like a conversion rather than interview. Questions Asked : 1.What Tech Stacks you know ? 2.What new Technology you want to learn ? 3.Are you enjoying Work from home ? 4.What happens behind the scenes when you type something on google and hit enter ? 5.If We all start using Electric Vehicles , then how will this benefit us ? 8.Any questions you want to ask ? Finally after waiting for exhausting 4 days , Fiserv announced that 23 people were selected for internship and I was one of them. Resources: ● For DSA, I have used 450dsa, InterviewBit, GeeksforGeeks, and LeetCode.I mainly used Geeksforgeeks practice and one question from each bucket on interviewbit. ● For OOPS ,OS,DBMS I referred to Love Babbar’s Roadmap and These Notes
